rules.rationale: This is the compile-time GRADE-STEP macro equation expanding a named proof term into the exact nested grading AST; it defines syntax and is not an execution rule or an additional mathematical fact.
This is the compile-time GRADE-PROGRAM macro equation defining the named whole-program AST from the function body and GRADE-STEP expansion.
This equation defines the proof-domain predicate isGradeNumber as the union of the MPY Int and Float subsorts.
This is the empty-sequence base equation for the recursively defined allGradeNumbers structural predicate.
This is the constructor-step recurrence defining allGradeNumbers by checking the head and structurally descending through the tail.
This equation defines the Int case of the named gradeEq summary in terms of the fixed intToF and eqF primitives.
This equation defines the Float case of the named gradeEq summary using K Float equality.
This guarded equation defines the nonnumeric totalization case of gradeEq as false, completing the named helper's cases.
This equation defines the Int case of the named gradeGt summary in terms of the fixed intToF and gtF primitives.
This equation defines the Float case of the named gradeGt summary using the fixed gtF primitive.
This guarded equation defines the nonnumeric totalization case of gradeGt as false, completing the named helper's cases.

This simplification adds the guarded dynamic-Val equality dispatch fact for the pre-existing applyCmp symbol. Stage 1 compiled this rule into VERIFICATION before proving the target and contains no earlier rule-free proof of this exact statement, so it is a trusted domain lemma rather than a proved derived lemma.

This simplification adds the guarded dynamic-Val greater-than dispatch fact for the pre-existing applyCmp symbol. Stage 1 compiled this rule into VERIFICATION before proving the target and contains no earlier rule-free proof of this exact statement, so it is a trusted domain lemma rather than a proved derived lemma.
This equation defines the named single-element gradeValue summary by the ordered equality and strict-cutoff grading table.
This is the empty-suffix base equation for the tail-recursive gradeAcc mathematical summary.
This is the constructor-step recurrence defining gradeAcc by appending the head's gradeValue and structurally recurring on the remaining suffix.
